text: Fredrik Backman's Beartown led to fines for Russian booksellers in March 2026. In early March 2026, Artem Faustov, co-founder of the bookstore Vse Svobodny, was fined fifty thousand rubles for selling the novel, even though an expert review by the Russian Book Union had concluded that the book contained nothing prohibited. On 16 March, the Leninsky District Court in Makhachkala fined the bookstore chain Chitai-Gorod, with the case materials naming Beartown and Us Against You as the grounds for the protocol.
meta_description: Beartown by Fredrik Backman: a Russian bookseller was fined fifty thousand rubles in early March 2026, and Chitai-Gorod was fined in Makhachkala.
changes: Adds the Makhachkala court fine and the expert-review hedge from the sources; chronological.
